title: XXL
lyrics:
[00:14] All my favorite songs are from twenty eighteen
[00:21] We flew around the world with our small town dreams
[00:28] I got your double XL hanging on my door
[00:35] And I still smell your perfume on the floor
[00:42] Bloodstream, full of desert lightnin'
[00:49] I still remember, I will forever
[00:56] Baby, we'll always have California
[01:03] Half of me will always be waitin' for ya
[01:10] Backseat secrets we won't ever tell
[01:17] You've been going out in the glitter and glow
[01:24] While I'm sitting here in this town we used to know
